cluster_disclosure.authority: CLAUDE.md rule 8 -- below G=5 complete days: point estimate, no interval, and say so
cluster_disclosure.pooling_note: G counts COMPLETE UTC DAYS across the runs a claim rests on, not windows within one; this field describes THIS run and a pooled claim must recompute it over its own days
cluster_disclosure.what_this_run_supports: A POINT ESTIMATE AND NO INTERVAL
cluster_disclosure.why_a_window_level_p_is_OPTIMISTIC: a window-level null treats windows as exchangeable draws. Windows inside one UTC day share coin, regime and book state, so the null variance is understated and any p computed on them is SMALLER than a day-clustered p would be. One day cannot be permuted at the ruled unit at all.

data/pm_5min/derived/harmful_exposure_ro.why_not_materialised: a DATA anchor is verified by content where it lives; copying it into the run dir would shadow the data-root symlink the frozen code needs

closure.closure_method: STATIC import walk (ast Import/ImportFrom, transitive) over the anchors' source. It is what the anchors can REACH, not what this run observed executing: a module reached only on a branch not taken is still listed, and a dynamic import (importlib, __import__) is NOT seen at all.
closure.why: anchors are imported from the run dir at 1b53929; every module STATICALLY REACHABLE from them that is NOT an anchor resolves at HEAD. Those whose bytes differ between HEAD and the freeze are named here — this run is not claiming they were frozen.

data_root.why: the frozen code derives its data root from __file__; the DATA is not frozen (it is the day being scored), so the run dir mirrors the repo's. Code from the freeze, data from today, and the receipt says which is which

load_bearing_keys.derived_from: an AST walk of the functions REACHABLE FROM `run_forward_day` that parse the manifest -- not from a list, not from every function in the file, and counting a function passed BY REFERENCE as an edge (BE21-R2)
load_bearing_keys.why: a manifest key the run path never reads cannot change what the run does; a key it reads can. That is the only defensible line between drift that must refuse and drift that may be disclosed.

manifest_drift.disclosure: this manifest has drifted from the sha the frozen candidate binds. The keys above are the whole of the difference, and the load-bearing set is DERIVED from the code that reads the manifest.

frozen_contract.working_tree_drift_is_not_fatal_because: `materialise_frozen` sources every CODE anchor from `_git_blob(FROZEN_COMMIT, k)` and refuses a mismatch there, so the bytes the run executes are the freeze's whatever the tree holds. Asserted from that function's own source, not stated: if it ever stops doing so, this gate refuses instead of disclosing.

masking.why: R-418 supplies PRESENT minus MASKED, so the blackout is already excluded when rows are built. A reader seeing 0 at the scoring seam must not conclude the day had no blackout.

roots.data_is_absolute_because: a bare worktree carries no data/; the tape and the market ledger are the repo's, not the checkout's, and this receipt says so rather than implying one root
roots.exec_tree_is_repo_means: true when this run's EXECUTING tree IS the repo root, so the code/anchor root and the data root coincide by COINCIDENCE; false from a worktree, where they differ by RULE and only `data/` stays absolute
roots.git_objects: shared object store — `git show <ref>:<path>` resolves the freeze blobs from any worktree, so `_git_blob` needs no per-tree root
